title: Cloud City: Cheat Sheet: Storage selection
city_concept: City Warehouses, Pneumatic Tubes & Courier Desks

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Merchants were storing summer wheat and 100-year historical stone monuments in prime heated city-center storefronts.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Warehouse Master Wendy established tiered storage: Active Storefronts (Standard), Deep Cold Cellars (Archive), and Fast Pneumatic Tubes for telegrams (Pub/Sub).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: Old stone monuments were moved to dry mountain caves (Archive), freeing up downtown storefronts.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Moving physical furniture between warehouses takes days; Cloud Storage Autoclass transitions digital objects automatically based on access.
